item_short_desc: Rothco's Multi-Chamber MOLLE Assault Pack offers extensive storage with 7 compartments, including a hidden laptop pocket. Made of durable polyester, it's perfect for outdoor adventures. The large main compartment features a mesh zippered pouch and a hydration pocket with bladder attachment points. Additionally, it has front zipper organizer pockets, twin zipper side pouches, and a top zipper pocket for easy access to essentials.
description: Rothco's Multi-Chamber MOLLE Assault Pack offers extensive storage with 7 compartments, including a hidden laptop pocket. Made of durable polyester, it's perfect for outdoor adventures. The large main compartment features a mesh zippered pouch and a hydration pocket with bladder attachment points. Additionally, it has front zipper organizer pockets, twin zipper side pouches, and a top zipper pocket for easy access to essentials. The padded back includes a rear zipper laptop compartment, and adjustable padded shoulder straps ensure comfortable wear. With top and twin side carry handles, it provides alternative carry capability, while the waist strap with 1 inch x 3 inch ID window adds convenience. Plus, 4 side cinch straps with quick-release buckles ensure a secure fit.
